description: Calls POST /v1/sequences/{name}/bump. Atomically advances the sequence by its configured `step` (a permanent, irreversible change to the stored `currentValue`) and returns the updated record — this is the same advance a template's createSeq()/getSeq() calls trigger during generation. Use jsonfabrica_update_sequence instead if you need to set an explicit `currentValue`/`step` rather than advancing by the existing step.

name.description: Exact name of the sequence to bump (advance by its configured step). Required.

name: jsonfabrica_bump_sequence

currentValue.description: Current stored counter value (unused by "uuid" sequences).

start.description: Initial value the sequence was created with.

type.description: Value kind produced on each bump.

title: Bump a JsonFabrica sequence
